alt_fr: Visage féminin sculpté aux traits paisibles, coiffe haute
alt_en: Carved female face with peaceful features and a tall headdress
description_fr: La coiffe dessine le contour d’un visage féminin aux traits paisibles. Le soin porté à la coiffure encadre l’expression du visage et laisse toute sa place à sa sérénité.
description_en: The headdress traces the outline of a female face with peaceful features. The care given to the hairstyle frames the expression and leaves full room for its serenity.
